indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attachment_links_attachment_target_unique ON public.attachment_links USING btree (attachment_id, target_module_type, target_linked_record_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attachment_links_pkey ON public.attachment_links USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX attachment_links_target_lookup_idx ON public.attachment_links USING btree (target_module_type, target_linked_record_id)
